results.sql: SELECT DISTINCT c.conrelid::regclass::text AS child, a.attname AS column FROM pg_constraint c JOIN pg_attribute a ON a.attrelid = c.conrelid AND a.attnum = ANY (c.conkey) WHERE c.contype = 'f'
